items.instruction: Play the exact final candidate continuously from first frame to final frame at 1.0x without skipping, scrubbing, or fast playback.
Confirm the candidate, all eight canonical source spans, intake timeline, evidence index, and claims audit are bound to the exact reviewed bytes.
Confirm all eight spans share the accepted canonical seed/save source-game-mount lineage and each span preserves its own pre-action-post session identity and GREEN cleanup evidence.
Confirm both generated cards and all eight gameplay chapters are present, and generated cards are not presented as gameplay evidence.
Confirm fact and quota records are visibly distinct, the calibration event is identity-ready, and the scoreboard or query revision visibly changes after the action.
Confirm the real manager-governance event is identity-ready and the AI-owned case reaches a provider-observed terminal business state rather than an inferred ACK or timeout.
Confirm the real receipt and PIP surface is visible, owner-subject-cycle-case identity stays stable, and the selected response state is provider-observed after the action.
Confirm the real promotion choice and compensation result are visible and bound to the same frozen case.
Confirm A, B, and C workforce outcomes use one owner-subject case from a hash-identical checkpoint and the no-opening outcome is visibly shown.
Confirm real project-choice and contribution or metrics result events are identity-ready and the result is provider-observed after the action.
Confirm X, Y, and Z incident surfaces appear in order and every transition plus closure is provider-observed after its action.
Confirm the identity-ready terminal institutional event remains bound to the carried debt or default-change cycle and the NEXT CYCLE boundary is readable.
Confirm every cross-character, cross-case, branch-comparison, and cross-cycle cut is explicitly labelled in Chinese and English and no montage invents continuity or causality.
Confirm every narration and subtitle claim is supported by the mapped visible shot, and no forbidden claim from the authority ledger or director treatment appears.
Confirm every visible character covered by the policy is provenance-bound historical material rather than a temporary, fixture, or generated substitute.
Confirm no prohibited world-generated official name is visible anywhere in the reviewed candidate.
Confirm no fixture, test, debug, ZGA, acceptance, launcher, loading, or other non-product UI is visible.
Confirm every included live clip was watched in full at 1.0x and every included still was inspected; sampled frames were not substituted for review.
Confirm compliance comes from clean source material and not from cropping, masking, blurring, redaction, or redrawing disallowed UI.
Confirm picture, game audio, narration, and Chinese-English subtitles remain present, synchronized, readable, and uninterrupted across every chapter and boundary.
